entities.name: Saint Traft
entities.description: A young priest of the Church of Avacyn on Innistrad, recognized as a saint, who was murdered by Withengar and became a geist.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The church of Innistrad that worships Avacyn.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: Vampire-afflicted province of Innistrad where Traft lived.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Archangel of Innistrad whose warrior-seraphs fought alongside Traft; she later turned against humans because of madness.

entities.name: Withengar
entities.description: A demonlord who murdered Saint Traft and was smitten by angels.

entities.name: Needle's Eye
entities.description: Place where the demons lured Traft and murdered him.

entities.name: Elbrus
entities.description: Weapon Traft used when tricked into killing cultists.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker whose machinations caused the madness affecting Avacyn.

entities.name: Skirsdag
entities.description: Ormendahl-worshiping cult that infiltrated the Church of Avacyn.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: A cathar who left the corrupted Church and founded the Order of Saint Traft with his geist.

entities.name: Order of Saint Traft
entities.description: Order created by Thalia and the Geist of Saint Traft to battle evil.

entities.name: Battle of Thraben
entities.description: Battle in which Traft possessed Thalia to fight the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi Titan whose madness affected Innistrad.

entities.name: Brisela
entities.description: Eldrazi killed by Thalia using Avacyn's spear with Sigarda's help.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: Angel who helped Thalia kill Brisela.

entities.name: Rem Karolus
entities.description: Fought the Phyrexian invaders alongside Saint Traft.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which Traft teamed up with Rem Karolus.

events.summary: Traft vanquishes evil creatures, especially demons along the Ashmouth, aided by Avacyn's warrior-seraphs.
events.quote: he vanquished all manner of evil creatures

events.summary: Demons lure Traft to Needle's Eye by ransoming a girl; he is tricked into killing cultists and murdered by Withengar.
An angelic attendant smites Withengar with the help of other angels.
events.quote: managed to smite Withengar with the help of other angels

events.summary: Traft does not enter the Blessed Sleep and becomes a geist.
events.quote: he never passed into the Blessed Sleep and instead became a geist to haunt the world

events.summary: Avacyn, affected by madness, turns against humans.
events.quote: the archangel turned against the very humans she was sworn to protect

events.summary: Thalia leaves the infiltrated church and creates the Order of Saint Traft with Traft's geist.
events.quote: created the Order of Saint Traft to battle evil

events.summary: In the Battle of Thraben Traft possesses Thalia to protect her and fight the Eldrazi.
events.quote: Traft possessed Thalia to protect her from Emrakul 's madness

events.summary: Thalia kills Brisela with Avacyn's spear and Sigarda's help.
Emrakul's presence forces Traft out of Thalia's body.
events.quote: forced Traft to leave Thalia's body

events.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion, Traft teams up with Rem Karolus.
events.quote: Saint Traft teamed up with Rem Karolus to fight the invaders

relations.quote: Saint Traft was a young priest in the Church of Avacyn
together with the Geist of Saint Traft
Saint Traft teamed up with Rem Karolus
